title: What a game folder was when GateKit last looked (game-fingerprint.json in the state, or in a copy's record)
description: Written by `gatekit game verify` and when a copy is made. Builders compare it with the game they read to record the build and the verdict in a database's metadata; `gatekit doctor` shows it. docs/contracts/cli.md, `game verify`.

copy.description: The copy's name, for a copy.

source.description: The source of invariants the verdict came from: Steam's app and depot manifests, a reference list, or none.

reference.description: The reference list the folder was held to.

files.description: The executables and libraries beside the game's executable.

mode.description: How the verdict was reached; absent when it is `unverified`.

from.description: For a copy made from the installed game: the installed game's verdict when its executables and libraries were the same files.

path.description: Inside the game folder, '/' between segments.
